## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.89%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%) show upside while VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -2.91%) and HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.31% | 1M: -0.21%) argue for caution.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Stocks vs Bonds rising: Stocks vs Bonds (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +8.19%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Credit stress creeping: Credit Spread (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.66%) → flat | ABOVE TREND with HYG (1W: -0.31% | 1M: -0.21%) BELOW TREND. Reflation signal from commodities: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +8.08%).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -2.40%) and Stocks vs Bonds ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +8.19%) point to risk preference offset by tighter credit and a slightly stronger dollar (Dollar Strength 1W: +0.36% | 1M: +0.81%) → flat | ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +31.66%). Energy holding: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +3.00%), while Financials showing weakness: Financials (XLF proxy) (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US outperforming: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.89%) while EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +7.99%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +3.71%) show regional dispersion.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation cooling: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +7.10%), ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +4.30%) and IWM CORRECTION (1W: -1.44% | 1M: +5.19%) indicate short-term profit-taking in riskier buckets.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Reflation theme intact: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +8.08%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +17.55%) while GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -3.28%) shows gold giving back ground.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy constructive: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +3.00%) and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +3.98%) — inflation/commodity reflation remains a tailwind.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership (XLK and SOXX both 1W/1M positive) and SPY ABOVE TREND are clear confirmations. DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION signals (IWM, IBIT, ARKK, EEM) show 1W weakness vs 1M strength — a MINOR but broad divergence to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor selective exposure to XLK (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%) and SOXX (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +31.66%) given momentum, and reduce exposure to long-duration TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -2.40%) and defensives like XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -3.87%) amid narrow breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%) and SOXX (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +31.66%) — watch for continuation if SPY/TLT remains ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Financials (XLF proxy) (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -2.36%) and Utilities (XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -3.87%)) — watch for further relative weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +8.08%) and BNO (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +17.55%) on reflation cues.  
BEARISH: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -3.28%) if real yields stay elevated.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 28.37 (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -2.91%) — rising from complacency; Stocks vs Bonds 8.7537 (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +8.19%) ABOVE TREND; Credit Spread 0.7357 (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.66%) → flat; Tech vs Financials 3.4683 (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +20.39%) ↑ rising.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and semiconductors showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +31.66%)).  
Key risk: narrow breadth plus credit/volatility divergence (HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.31% | 1M: -0.21%); VXX RECOVERY (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -2.91%)) — monitor for spillover into cyclical buckets.
